infographic.title: Inside a Magnetic Level Gauge
infographic.alt: Infographic showing how a magnetic level gauge works with float, magnet and flag indicator
steps: The side chamber connects to the vessel, so liquid rises to the same level.
A float with a built in magnet rides on the liquid surface.
Magnetic flags outside the chamber turn from white to red as the float passes.
Optional switches and transmitters read the same magnet for remote use.
